name: BEN-16
description: A 16 bit version of the classic single bus breadboard computer: A and B registers, an adding and subtracting ALU, carry and zero flags, an output register, and every instruction in five clock steps.

programs.name: Add two numbers
programs.description: 28 + 14: OUTPUT reads 42 and the machine halts

programs.name: Count up and down
programs.description: OUTPUT counts up in steps of 256 until the sum carries out of 16 bits, then back down to 0, for ever

programs.name: Multiply
programs.description: 123 x 45 by repeated addition: OUTPUT reads 5535 and the machine halts

programs.name: Fibonacci
programs.description: OUTPUT shows 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5 and on to 46368, the largest that fits in 16 bits, then starts again
